objective: Prepare and publish QIF v0.3.0 design milestone release

assignment.assignment_reason: Builder owns release metadata edits, verification, tag, push, and GitHub Release execution.

capability_fit.rationale: The release target is already designed and reviewed; the remaining work is metadata, verification, and publication.

required_sections: package version, changelog, release notes, runtime log
acceptance_criteria: v0.3.0 tag and GitHub Release exist and accurately describe the design milestone

review_criteria.evidence_required: release notes and README do not claim completed runtime schemas or semantic truth

blocker_semantics.trigger_condition: metadata claims v0.3 runtime implementation or semantic truth is complete
blocker_semantics.recovery_action: revise release notes and metadata before tag

hri_projection.speech_bubble: I can release the design milestone cleanly.
hri_projection.current_action: Update metadata, verify, commit, tag, push, and publish release.
hri_projection.next_action: Submit release metadata for Council review before publication.
